Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 11.4; final formative gate. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7ENQC6441TVS9J6NSC4K, bd-01M35A7EWX4BB7WMSY558THJ4K.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own final representative-scientist task round on the full four-configuration app. Reuse the predefined protocol and early findings with unfamiliar material; separate actual performance from interpretation and scope claims.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Demonstrate structure, repeated events, backward reference, alternative/joint semantics, coarse/untimed/failed/external states, policy distinction and independent exported-row recovery.
2. Initial target is >=90% predefined critical-task completion without rescue and no recurring critical scientific misinterpretation; report participant/task denominators, failures and uncertainty.
3. Unresolved failures create bounded repair/retest work; absent human evaluation stays blocked, not replaced by automated screenshots.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Withhold four-screen comprehension qualification and publish only the actual evaluation scope; do not weaken task definitions after seeing failures.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [UX] Validate final scientist comprehension after repairs
